expectNote: Category is looked up by product code in a catalog of 200 products (each on 2 of the 400 rows); no code range or other column explains it. A list of fixed values (more than 12 entries): the learn sends ONE automatic round asking for the rule behind it ("Column \"Category\" is a list of 200 fixed values, one per Product code ..."), the honest answer keeps the lookup, and the list is asked about at Save ("Category is a list of 200 fixed values taken from your example (one for each Product code)"); this case answers "Keep it" (answers.copiedList), so it scores verified. May break: a rule invented from the code (a band on its digits, a prefix), or the list given up as unsupported.
